normalized: togeojson's GeometryCollections are a row per member, with the feature's properties
coordinates are x and y; a member with a coordinate that is not finite or missing is left out, as are empty rings
nested property values (objects and arrays) are their JSON.stringify text
lone surrogates in keys and values are U+FFFD, as UTF-8 carries text (TextEncoder's replacement)
bounding boxes are left out: tables carry none
togeojson's NetworkLink features (links to other documents, with their Region's box) are left out: mbmap/data reads none

deviations.label: nesting past MAX_XML_DEPTH
deviations.why: xmldom has no depth limit; mbmap/data refuses documents nested deeper than 256 (AGENTS.md §8.2)

deviations.label: 100000 levels
deviations.why: as above; togeojson overflows the stack on it

deviations.label: attributes past MAX_XML_ATTRIBUTES
deviations.why: xmldom has no attribute limit; mbmap/data refuses more than 1024 on one element

deviations.label: malformed internal subset
deviations.why: xmldom checks declarations in an internal subset; mbmap/data skips the subset (nothing in it is ever used)

deviations.label: XML declaration version 2
deviations.why: xmldom checks an XML declaration's version, encoding and standalone parts; mbmap/data only that it comes first
